_meta.method: Demand 1-10 is a judgement anchored on eBay UK page-1 sold counts measured 25 Sep 2026 (see wallart/research/DEMAND.md and raw/ebay_uk_page1_2026-09-25.json), NOTHS rankings, and labelled third-party estimates. share = fraction of 7M total; each store sums to 1/7. 'core' niches are the store's primary market; the rest are diversifiers.
_meta.phrases: example_phrases are usable text; [brackets] are buyer-personalisation slots; text in (parentheses) is source/attribution/note and is NOT printed. avoid_or_check lists phrases seen in the market that are copyrighted, trade-marked or need a rights check.
_meta.fields: competition = listing count and seller strength on eBay UK page 1; seasonal_months = months listings must be LIVE (1=Jan).

As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord (Joshua 24:15)
This is the day which the Lord hath made (Psalm 118:24)
The Lord bless thee, and keep thee (Numbers 6:24)
Faith, hope, love - the greatest of these is love
Be strong and of a good courage (Joshua 1:9)
Come unto me, all ye that labour (Matthew 11:28)
For God so loved the world (John 3:16)
He that dwelleth in the secret place (Psalm 91)
avoid_or_check: God grant me the serenity... (Serenity Prayer - see risk note)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: weak for PRINTS - 'bible verse print' 13,000+ results, 0 of 132 page-1 listings with sales; 'psalm print' 0; 'christian print' 3 with sales ('Jesus Divine Mercy A4 Print' 62). Prayer CARDS sell: 'SERENITY PRAYER Embossed Praying Hands CREDIT CARD SIZE' 320; 'The Lords Prayer - Framed' 179. US Etsy: 'Scripture & Faith-Based' printable wall art '25,000+ monthly searches, low-medium competition' (insightagent.app, third-party estimate, unverified). Better on Etsy/Amazon US than eBay UK.

niches.name: Irish & Celtic blessings, Scottish/Welsh blessings
example_phrases: May the road rise up to meet you (traditional Irish blessing)
May you have warm words on a cold evening (traditional)
May God hold you in the palm of His hand
Céad Míle Fáilte - a hundred thousand welcomes
May your home always be too small to hold all your friends (traditional)
May the luck of the Irish be with you
Home is where the heart is - Cymru
Deep peace of the running wave to you (Celtic benediction, trad.)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'irish blessing print' only 307 results, 3 page-1 listings with sales (US-made wood sign 36); 'celtic blessing' page 1 is plaques/keyrings (114, 66); 'irish print' 0 sales on page 1. Low competition, low measured demand; St Patrick's Day (17 Mar) and US Irish-American market are the upside.

niches.name: Islamic calligraphy-style & English Islamic typography (Ayat al-Kursi, Bismillah, Nikah, Eid, Ramadan)
example_phrases: Bless this home - Islamic house dua
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'Canvas Ayatul Kursi Calligraphy Islamic Wall Art Print' 122 sold £14.89; '99 Names of Allah Poster Islamic Arabic Print & English meanings LARGE A1' 79+; 'Beautiful Islamic Abstract Calligraphy Canvas' 76+; 'La ilaha illa Allah Shahada Calligraphy A4 Poster' 14. 'ayatul kursi print' only 217 results; 'bismillah print' 182 results, 0 sold. Eid/Ramadan decor sells as stickers/banners (3,333; 1,453). Nikah cards/banners 246, 121. Third-party (accio.com): '78% of UK Muslims interested in brands stocking Ramadan/Eid products' - unverified. Arabic calligraphy must be correct - get native review.

niches.name: Hindu, Sikh & Jewish typography (Om, Ik Onkar, Diwali, Shalom)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'hindu wall art' 2,200+ results, sellers are tapestries/metal Buddha plaques (84, 38); 'sikh wall art' 126 results, top 31 sold (a historical poster); 'diwali decor' 0 sold on page 1; 'jewish print' 0; 'waheguru print' 2 results. Minimal measured demand on eBay; keep small, script accuracy essential.

niches.name: Remembrance & military commemoration (public-domain war poetry) (diversifier)
example_phrases: They shall grow not old... (Laurence Binyon, For the Fallen - d.1943, PD in UK)
In Flanders fields the poppies blow (John McCrae, d.1918 - PD)
At the going down of the sun
Their name liveth for evermore (Ecclesiasticus, PD)
avoid_or_check: When you go home, tell them of us and say... (Kohima Epitaph, J.M. Edmonds d.1958 - UK copyright until 2028: AVOID)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'IN FLANDERS' FIELDS WWI POEM BY JOHN MCRAE - MILITARY ART PRINT' 110 sold £9.60; 'remembrance print' 31,000+ results; 'for the fallen print' 132 results, 0 sold on page 1. Regimental badges are Crown/MOD-protected - avoid. Poppy symbol: the Royal British Legion owns the two-petal poppy TM - use generic flowers or none.

niches.name: Wedding readings, house blessings & public-domain love poetry (diversifier)
example_phrases: Sonnet 116 - Let me not to the marriage of true minds (Shakespeare, PD)
How do I love thee? Let me count the ways (E.B. Browning, PD)
The Passionate Shepherd to His Love (Marlowe, PD)
Whither thou goest, I will go (Ruth 1:16, PD)
Bless this home and all who enter
avoid_or_check: I carry your heart... AVOID (e.e. cummings, in copyright)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'Personalised Captain Corelli's Mandolin Poem Wedding Anniversary A4 Print' 95 and 'Captain Corelli's Mandolin Wedding Reading... Print' 128 sold - shows demand for wedding-reading prints, but that text is COPYRIGHT (Louis de Bernieres) - substitute PD readings. 'bless this home print' 323 results, 'May God Bless this home' wood sign 79.

niches.name: UK town/city/county typographic prints (name + postcode district + founding/landmark words + small vector ornament)
niches.evidence: Prior eBay UK research (30 Aug 2026, pod/RESEARCH_WHAT_SELLS.md): 'Vintage Scarborough... Railway Travel Poster' 27+ sold; 'Vintage Bude' 19+; 'hebden bridge print' 201 competing listings vs 3,900,000 for 'wall art print a4'. This run: 'town print' 230,000+ results but 1 sold-bearing listing; 'yorkshire print' 1. NOTHS 'town print': skyline and hand-drawn place prints £19-£34. Demand is diffuse (per-town), competition per town is tiny. 4,469 UK places available in repo data.

niches.name: Regional dialect & sayings (Yorkshire, Geordie, Scouse, Brummie, Lancashire, Black Country, Cockney, Scots, Welsh)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'yorkshire dialect print' 69 results, 0 sold; 'yorkshire sayings print' 58 results, 0 sold; 'dialect print' 0 sold; 'scouse print' 0; 'scottish quote print' 0; 'welsh quote print' 46 results, 8 sold-bearing listings. Off-eBay a retail ecosystem exists (lighthouselane.co.uk, thegreatyorkshireshop.co.uk from £12.50, elliebeanprints.co.uk, theyorkshireprintcompany.co.uk). Demand real but not on eBay - Etsy/NOTHS channel.

niches.name: Motivational & inspirational prints from public-domain texts (Desiderata, If-, Invictus, Man in the Arena, Stoic sayings)
example_phrases: Desiderata - Go placidly amid the noise and haste (Ehrmann, d.1945 - PD UK)
If you can keep your head... (Kipling, If-, PD)
I am the master of my fate, I am the captain of my soul (Henley, Invictus, PD)
The man in the arena (T. Roosevelt 1910, PD)
avoid_or_check: Do not go gentle... AVOID (Dylan Thomas, in copyright)
The obstacle is the way (Marcus Aurelius paraphrase - modern book title, TM risk; use 'What stands in the way becomes the way')
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'A3 - do it anyway - Mother Teresa INSPIRATIONAL MOTIVATIONAL QUOTE POSTER' 223 sold £4.15 (but text is Kent M. Keith's copyrighted Paradoxical Commandments); 'DESIDERATA Inspirational Motivational Poem Quote Poster Vintage Style Paper A4' 80 sold £4.75; 'MAN IN THE ARENA... Poem Quote Poster' 45; 'INVICTUS...' 36; 'Vintage Winston Churchill Motivational Quotes Print' 37. Generic 'inspirational quote print' 19,000+ results, only 2 sold-bearing listings. Etsy: 'Minimalist Quote Prints 50,000+ monthly searches, very high competition' (insightagent.app / prior repo research, third-party estimate).

niches.name: Literary & book-lover quotes from public-domain authors (Austen, Shakespeare, Wilde, Brontë, Carroll, Dickens, Burns)
example_phrases: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart (Austen)
I declare after all there is no enjoyment like reading (Austen)
Though she be but little, she is fierce (Shakespeare)
To thine own self be true (Shakespeare)
We are such stuff as dreams are made on (Shakespeare)
Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same (E. Brontë)
It was the best of times (Dickens)
A room without books is like a body without a soul (attrib. Cicero)
avoid_or_check: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken - MISATTRIBUTED to Wilde, avoid attribution
Hope is the thing with feathers (Dickinson, PD in UK/US - check edition)
Not all those who wander... AVOID (Tolkien, in copyright)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'ALICE IN WONDERLAND PRINT PICTURE VINTAGE STYLE GLOSS A4 UNFRAMED TIME FOR TEA' 89 sold £3.99; 'Alice in Wonderland Wall Art on Dictionary Book Page' 35. NOTHS: Bookishly 'A Room Without Books...' £26 and 'Little But Fierce' £26; Penny and Me 'Not Now I'm Reading' £9.95 - all top-15 for 'quote print'/'motivational print'.

niches.name: Office, work-from-home & study motivation (diversifier)
example_phrases: Do more of what makes you happy
Meeting? Could have been an email
avoid_or_check: The expert in anything was once a beginner (attrib. Helen Hayes - check)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'office wall art quote' 12,000+ results, sold leaders are vinyl decals (344+); 'wfh print' 43 results, prints absent; 'office print' dominated by calendars. Weak measured print demand.

niches.name: Minimalist décor words & Scandi-style quote prints (colour/room-led) (diversifier)
example_phrases: But what if it all goes right?
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'pink lips print a4 picture QUOTE UNFRAMED TYPOGRAPHY a4 gloss' 216 sold £3.99; 'be own kind beautiful print a4 picture UNFRAMED typography wall art' 151 sold £3.99; 'be kind to yourself PRINT PICTURE a4 unframed bee' 95; 'Motivational Prints Funny Quote Poster Modern Inspirational Minimalist Art Print' 128+ £2.99. 'quote print' 110,000+ results with 2 sold-bearing listings; 'boho quote print' 1; 'self love print' 0; 'mental health print' 0. Desenio/NOTHS scale in this style (NOTHS: 'It Is What It Is' £7.50, '...But What If It All Goes Right?' £12). Very high competition, low eBay conversion.

niches.name: Dictionary-definition & word-meaning prints (diversifier)
niches.evidence: eBay UK: 'dictionary definition print' 336 results, 0 sold; 'HANGRY DICTIONARY DEFINITION, FUNNY QUOTE KITCHEN - FRAMED' listed by canvasartshop (no count). NOTHS 'Personalised Definition Print, Custom Photo Gift' £16 ranks top-10 for 'personalised print'. Works best as a personalisation format inside stores 1 and 3.

stores.name: Personalised Couples, Family & Home
stores.focus: Buyer-personalised word-art for couples and households: family names, Mr & Mrs, anniversaries, new home, where-we-met, 'our words'. Diversifiers: Christmas family typography, personalised kitchen, surname meaning.

stores.name: Baby, Nursery & Children
stores.focus: New-baby birth-details and nursery name prints, christening/godparents, kids' rooms. Diversifiers: educational wall charts (strongest measured non-personalised demand), kids' affirmations.

stores.name: Gifts for Them & Milestones
stores.focus: Recipient-led personalised gifts: Mum/Nan, Dad/Grandad, friends/sisters/colleagues/neighbours, teachers, birthdays, graduation, retirement. Diversifiers: occupation thank-yous, pet-parent prints.

stores.name: Funny Home: Bathroom, Kitchen & House Rules
stores.focus: Room-led humour and rules lists for bathroom/loo, kitchen, laundry, hallway; drinks humour. Diversifiers: pet humour, seasonal decor typography.

stores.name: Bar, Man Cave, Garden & Hobbies
stores.focus: Home bar/pub, man cave/garage, shed/summer house/allotment, caravan/hot tub, hobbies - UK 'sign' phrases in print form, no brands. Diversifiers: retro café menus, gym/sport, games room.

stores.name: Faith, Memorial & Comfort
stores.focus: Public-domain memorial poems, pet memorial, sympathy; Christian, Irish/Celtic, Islamic, Hindu/Sikh/Jewish typography. Diversifiers: remembrance (PD war poetry), PD wedding readings and house blessings.

stores.name: Places, Words & Motivation
stores.focus: UK town/county typography, regional dialect, public-domain motivational and literary quotes. Diversifiers: office/WFH, minimalist decor words, definition prints. Weakest measured eBay demand - best candidate for Etsy/NOTHS-style cross-listing and for trimming volume.
